session_id_recipe: m1p session_id = UUIDv5(NameSpaceURL, 'opencode:' + sessionID): opencode session ids are ses_<26 chars> (schema/identifier.ts), not UUIDs; mark1.js sessionUUID, opencode.SessionUUID and selfcheck.py compute the same value
idem_key_recipe: idem_key = HMAC_tenant(session_id, message_id, request_id) with session_id := SessionUUID(sessionID), message_id := StepFinishPart.messageID (the assistant message), request_id := StepFinishPart.id -- one step-finish part per LLM round-trip, and its id is unique where assistantMessageID is reused across a tool-loop turn (the spike's open dedupe risk, closed by the part id)

usage_field_map.input_tokens: part.tokens.input (session.ts getUsage: inputTokens MINUS cache read and write -- Anthropic semantics, not OpenAI's)
usage_field_map.output_tokens: part.tokens.output + part.tokens.reasoning (getUsage subtracts reasoning from output; it is billed as output)
usage_field_map.model: AssistantMessage.providerID + '/' + AssistantMessage.modelID from the message.updated line of the same messageID
usage_field_map.not_mapped: part.cost (opencode's own price computation) and AssistantMessage.tokens (the LAST step's tokens, overwritten per step -- never a per-call count)

containment_rule: every stream head is an assistant message.updated whose info.path.cwd is the session cwd (processor.ts runs session.updateMessage before any step-finish part); the capture dir is shared by every project, so the cwd is the stream own attribution

out_of_workspace_streams.reason: the capture dir holds every project sessions; this stream's path.cwd resolves outside the enabled root, so it is never tailed (04 §0.3 invariant 3, 04 §2.1)

never_emit.reason: a re-published part with identical numbers is the streaming-rewrite duplicate (07 §7 layer 1); one Usage
AssistantMessage.tokens is the last step's count overwritten per step (processor.ts step-finish), never summed; the line only supplies model and cwd

hooks.composition: mark1.js hook(): {hook_event_name: <plugin hook or bus event type>, session_id: SessionUUID(sessionID), cwd: <plugin input.directory>, ...vendor fields at top level}; `event` hooks pass {sessionID} only, chat.message and tool.execute.before pass their input verbatim, tool.execute.after passes {tool, sessionID, callID} (args dropped)
